title: License-plate structural test vectors
description: Deterministic fixture of license-plate candidates paired with structural rejection reasons. Mirrors the Swift ``detectLicensePlate`` regex at PIIDetector.swift:795 (pattern declared at :789-792).

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed used to generate this artifact, recorded for reproducibility.

vectors.description: Test vectors. Each record is one license-plate candidate with its expected structural verdict.

text.description: Full candidate string (label + separator + plate value).

plate.description: The plate portion (two alphanumeric segments with optional inner separator).

valid.description: Whether the candidate matches the Swift license-plate regex shape.

rejection_reason.description: Which structural rule rejects this plate, or null if valid.
